Language model

A program that reads tokens and predicts the next token.

Agent

A program that prepares a request for a language model and uses the returned answer.

Prompt

The ordered tokens given to a language model.

Cache

Temporary storage that keeps completed work so it can be reused.

Context limit

The largest number of input and output tokens a model can use in one request.

Specification

A written set of requirements and rules for work that must be completed.

Harness

The program around a language model. It assembles requests, provides tools, and coordinates work.

Interactive video companion · under five minutes

Cache, context, and better agents.

A cached prompt can reduce repeated calculation. It cannot increase the context limit, and it cannot make unrelated specification text useful.

01

What does the server save?

Read these definitions in order. Then send the same beginning twice.

Token

A small piece of text stored as a number.

text → token numbers
Model server

A program that runs the language model and manages its temporary storage.

request → model → returned answer
Prompt prefix

The exact token numbers at the beginning of a prompt.

[18, 4, 91, ...]
Prompt cache

Saved model calculation work for a prompt prefix.

same beginning → reuse
Cached input token

An input token whose earlier calculation work was reused.

still part of the input
Cache hit

A request that finds matching saved work and reuses it.

found → reuse
Cora · model-server view

I save calculation work. I do not remove tokens.

The first request calculates every token. A later request with the same beginning can reuse the saved work and calculate only the changed end.

First request: the server calculates work for every input token.

Optional deeper view: what the saved work contains
Model layer

One calculation stage inside a language model.

Vector

An ordered list of numbers made by a model layer.

Key and value vectors

Vectors made for earlier token positions and read while processing later positions.

Key and value cache

Temporary storage containing those vectors. A prompt cache can preserve matching vectors for reuse by a later request.

04

The harness selects, runs, and checks.

A harness is the program around the language model. It assembles each request, provides tools, and coordinates the work.

Stable contract · useful cached beginning
One slot has at most one active booking.
The same request key creates no second booking.
A notification failure does not cancel a booking.

02 · PROVE FAILUREImplementer

05

Three rules to remember.

These rules are the complete five-minute conclusion.

01

Cache stable work.

Caching reduces repeated calculation. It does not create more input space.

02

Select relevant text.

Include a specification because the task needs it, not merely because it can be cached.

03

Validate the result.

The workflow must remain correct when saved work is unavailable.

Technical sources: OpenAI prompt caching, vLLM automatic prefix caching, and Lost in the Middle.
